user.title: Add light defaults
user.description: Used when a light turns on from off and the call leaves out brightness or color. Pick one or more lights to share these values. A light group also covers the lights in it, except lights with defaults of their own. Leave either value empty to keep the lights' usual behavior for it.

data_description.entities: Lights that already have defaults in another entry aren't listed.
data_description.name: Shown on the Light Defaults page. Leave empty to use the light names.
data_description.temperature: Lights without color temperature support ignore this.

error.already_configured: Some of these lights were just given defaults in another entry.
error.no_defaults: Set a brightness, a color temperature or both.
